name: The Crimean War and the Suppression of the "Kyiv Cossack Movement" (1853–1856) (C0061)

techniques.comment: The mass enrollment of peasants into the militia: "The trigger was the publication, during the Crimean War of 1853–1856, of Emperor Nicholas I's manifesto providing for the creation of a mobile state militia"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 4 2007) - the manifesto and levy decrees of 29 January 1855 (Nos. 28.991–28.993); the Kyiv governorate was not on the list of governorates called up, and the peasants took the empire-wide summons as addressed to themselves(Citation: Полное собрание законов Российской империи. Собрание второе. Том XXX, отделение 1 (1855) 1856).

The armed suppression of the peasants' anti-serfdom movement (the "Kyiv Cossack movement"): "To suppress the 'Cossack movement' the government threw in regular troops and police. Bloody clashes occurred in several villages and towns"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 4 2007).
